# Influencer marketing in Argentina and Latin America: our campaigns for Gemini, Absolute and Jorgito

Besides UGC, AG Agency now runs full influencer marketing: we find the creators, manage them and build the campaign end to end. Here is what we have been doing, for whom, and why more agencies from other countries keep getting in touch.

## What we mean by influencer marketing and management

An influencer is not just a name with followers. Someone has to pick the profile that fits the brand, negotiate, coordinate the script, the deliverables and the publishing date, and then look at what happened. We handle all of it: profile selection, negotiation and coordination with creators, content, publishing and results tracking. You get one point of contact instead of fifteen open chats.

## The campaigns: Gemini, Absolute and Jorgito

We ran an influencer campaign for Jorgito, and we are currently working on another for Absolute. We also produced content with Argentine creators for Gemini, Google's AI assistant, on TikTok.

The Absolute and Gemini campaigns are for a Mexican agency. The agency owns the client and the strategy; we supply the influencers and the production in Argentina, working under their brand. It is the same white-label setup we already use for UGC: your client sees your brand, not ours.

## Why a Mexican agency looks for influencers in Argentina

Because an Argentine campaign has to be run by someone who knows how the audience talks, which cities and time slots matter, and which creators have a real community. From the outside that is hard to see. It is the same logic we apply to everything: Spanish is not one language, and for an ad it is twenty. We cast creators by country, not by language.

## We are expanding across Latin America

Inquiries are already coming from agencies and brands outside Argentina, and we are adding creators and influencers from other countries in the region. If you are an agency and need to cover a market where you have no team, tell us about the campaign and we will build a tailored proposal.

## We are looking for influencers and creators in Argentina

If you have an Instagram or TikTok account and want to work with brands, you can [sign up as an influencer](https://agustinagineragency.com/registro.html?tipo=influencer). We reach out when a campaign fits your profile. And if you are a brand or agency, ask for a proposal and we will send you profiles that have already worked with us.

If you are still building the budget, read [what UGC costs in Argentina](https://agustinagineragency.com/en/blog/cuanto-cuesta-el-ugc-argentina/) and what to know about [usage rights](https://agustinagineragency.com/en/blog/derechos-de-uso-ugc/) before you run ads.

## FAQ

Do you run influencer marketing outside Argentina?

We build campaigns with Argentine creators for agencies in other countries, such as Mexico, and we are expanding into other Latin American markets.

Do you work with agencies?

Yes. We work white label: the agency keeps the client and the strategy, and we supply the influencers and the production.

How much does an influencer campaign cost?

It depends on the profiles, the number of pieces and the usage rights. We do not sell fixed packs: every proposal is tailored.

How do I join as an influencer?

Fill in the influencer sign-up form. We reach out when a campaign fits your profile.

From the research and discovery phase, to defining the strategy and implementing technology solutions, our team focuses on creating relevant and unique experiences that connect emotionally with customers.

Customer experience is not just about technology, it is about people. That is why, at Ogilvy, we work closely with our clients to understand their needs and goals, and create experiences that surprise them and exceed their expectations.

Our client-centric approach has enabled us to create successful experience solutions in a wide variety of industries. From financial services to automotive to food and beverage, our experience solutions have helped brands around the world differentiate themselves and create lasting relationships with their customers.

From creating impactful social content and managing communities to influencer programs, advanced social listening, and high-engagement activations, our approach brings together creativity, data, and technology to achieve measurable results.
